Package com.esignal.jstandard.beans.requestoption Description

Purpose of this package is to host all available request options for the History Bar, History tick and intraday requests. Multiple request options can be added to HistoricalTickRequest, IntradayHistoricalTickRequest and HistoricalBarRequest, but not all combinations are supported. For in depth information about the combinations that are allowed, please contact developer support group.
